note: SpamAway ships one Webform handler plugin (spamaway_anti_spam_forms) that rejects submissions failing an IP-frequency check and/or a similarity check. It has no global settings page (configure=null); all tuning is per-webform handler settings stored in the webform config entity at webform.webform.<id> -> handlers.<handler_id>.settings. Bypass via permission 'spamaway bypass spam detection' or $settings['spamaway_bypass_anti_spam']=TRUE. Medium cases create a webform with the handler configured to known values and the agent reads them back from the webform config; hard cases have the agent attach the handler to a webform, or change handler settings, verified against the live webform config entity. All test webforms are namespaced spamaway_eval_*.

evals.prompt: How do I add SpamAway spam protection to a single Drupal webform, and what is the machine name of the plugin it provides?
evals.expected_output: Open the webform's Settings -> Emails / Handlers, Add handler, choose 'SpamAway - Anti spam handler' (plugin id spamaway_anti_spam_forms), configure and save. There is no global settings page.

evals.prompt: In the SpamAway module for Drupal, how can trusted users or a whole environment skip the spam checks?
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'spamaway bypass spam detection' permission to trusted roles, or set $settings['spamaway_bypass_anti_spam'] = TRUE; in settings.php to disable checking globally.

evals.prompt: What signals does the SpamAway webform handler use to decide a submission is spam, and name a couple of the settings that tune them?
evals.expected_output: Two checks: an IP-frequency check (spamaway_ip_check_enabled, spamaway_anti_spam_ip_period, spamaway_anti_spam_allowed_ip_count) and a similarity check on named fields (spamaway_anti_spam_field_names, spamaway_anti_spam_threshold_percentage, spamaway_anti_spam_allowed_count).

evals.prompt: On this site a webform named 'spamaway_eval_m1' has the SpamAway handler attached. Inspect its live configuration and report the value configured for the allowed IP count (spamaway_anti_spam_allowed_ip_count).
The webform 'spamaway_eval_m2' on this site uses the SpamAway handler. Inspect its live configuration and report which field name(s) SpamAway compares for similarity (spamaway_anti_spam_field_names).
evals.expected_output: spamaway_anti_spam_field_names is 'email' in the handler settings on webform spamaway_eval_m2.

evals.prompt: The webform 'spamaway_eval_h1' on this site has no spam protection. Attach the SpamAway anti-spam handler to it and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a handler of plugin id spamaway_anti_spam_forms to webform.webform.spamaway_eval_h1 (via Emails/Handlers UI or $webform->addWebformHandler(...)).

evals.prompt: On webform 'spamaway_eval_h2', the SpamAway handler is already attached. Reconfigure it so the IP check is DISABLED and the allowed count of similar submissions (spamaway_anti_spam_allowed_count) is 3. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In the handler settings on webform spamaway_eval_h2, set spamaway_ip_check_enabled to false and spamaway_anti_spam_allowed_count to 3.
